flagged.headline: Flagged as anomalous
flagged.detail: This value deviates significantly from the historical average for this reporting entity — {baseline} over the previous {periods} comparable periods, a deviation of more than {percent}%.
flagged.detailLimitedOne: This value was compared against {baseline}, the only earlier period for this reporting entity, and deviates by more than {percent}%. The check rests on limited history (1 period).
flagged.detailLimited: This value was compared against {baseline}, the average of the {count} earlier periods for this reporting entity, and deviates by more than {percent}%. The check rests on limited history ({count} periods).
flagged.detailNoBaseline: This value deviates significantly from the historical average for this reporting entity.

ceiling.headline: Above the first-period ceiling
ceiling.leadFirstPeriod: This is the first period of this series, so there is no earlier period to compare it with.
ceiling.leadZeroAverage: The earlier periods of this series average zero, so no deviation can be computed from them.
ceiling.detail: {amount} is above the plausibility ceiling of {ceiling} for this category — please check the evidence document and the unit (an extra zero?). If the figure is right, explain it in the variance reason.
ceiling.detailCorrected: {amount} × the volume correction factor {factor} = {corrected}, above the plausibility ceiling of {ceiling} for this category — please check the evidence document, the unit and the factor. If the figure is right, explain it in the variance reason.
ceiling.detailLine: An equipment line of {capacity} is above the plausibility ceiling of {ceiling} installed capacity per line — please check the nameplate or the inventory and the unit. If the figure is right, explain it in the variance reason.
ceiling.detailRefillRatio: An equipment line's refill of {refill} is above its limit of {ceiling}, 125% of the line's {capacity} capacity — please check the service form or invoice and the unit. If the figure is right, explain it in the variance reason.
ceiling.detailRefillCap: An equipment line's refill of {refill} is above the {ceiling} per-line limit — please check the service form or invoice and the unit. If the figure is right, explain it in the variance reason.
ceiling.detailUnknown: The figure is above the plausibility ceiling for this category — please check the evidence document and the unit.

clean.headline: Within the expected range
clean.detail: Compared against {baseline}, the average of the previous {periods} comparable periods, and within {percent}%.

cleanLimited.headline: Within range on limited history
cleanLimited.detailOne: Compared against {baseline}, the only earlier period for this reporting entity, and within {percent}%. The check rests on limited history (1 period).
cleanLimited.detail: Compared against {baseline}, the average of the {count} earlier periods for this reporting entity, and within {percent}%. The check rests on limited history ({count} periods).

firstPeriod.headline: First-period record
firstPeriod.detail: There is no earlier period to compare with — please check the evidence document and the unit.

notEvaluated.headline: Not checked for anomalies
notEvaluated.noFigure: This category produces no calculated figure, so there is nothing to compare against its history.
notEvaluated.zeroAverage: The previous {periods} comparable periods average zero, so no deviation can be computed from them.
notEvaluated.zeroAverageLimited: The earlier committed periods for this reporting entity average zero, so no deviation can be computed from them.
notEvaluated.scoredBefore: This entry was scored when the check needed {periods} earlier committed periods. It had fewer ({count}), so it was not checked.

note.one: 1 entry was not checked for anomalies — no usable history to compare against.
note.other: {count} entries were not checked for anomalies — no usable history to compare against.
